_说明: viewer3d.html?model=civic_core 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。中层核心区的政务区：天城议会、执政厅、政务院、中央储备署、文化署五栋建筑同在一个场景，各自一个热点；五个中层标记都接到这里。周边巨构楼群、上层甲板、悬浮轨道（bg_*）只在成图里。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 广场北侧的立法大厅：高台基、宽阔台阶、青铜大门、柱廊门廊与钢肋发光鼓座穹顶；议会握有戒严权，中央储备署隶属议会。
desc.en: The legislative hall north of the plaza: raised podium, broad steps, bronze doors, a portico and a steel-ribbed glowing dome. The Council holds the power of martial law; the Central Reserve Office reports to it.

desc.zh: 退台式行政塔楼，底层是办理跨层通行许可的大厅：安检门、闸机与防撞柱。
desc.en: A stepped-back administrative tower whose base is the hall that issues cross-tier permits, with security portals, turnstiles and bollards.

desc.zh: 合院式部委楼，天桥跨过大道连向执政厅（与执政厅是否同一机构卡没说明，地图分开标）。
desc.en: A courtyard ministry block linked to the Executive Office by a skybridge (the card does not say whether they are the same body; the map marks them separately).

desc.zh: 发行以太元的金库式建筑：粗面石基座、少窗、青铜大门与运钞装卸口。
desc.en: The vault-like building that issues the Aether Yuan: rusticated base, few windows, bronze doors and a loading bay.

desc.zh: 负责出版审查：锯齿天窗的阅览大厅与实墙档案翼。
desc.en: Handles publication review: a reading hall with sawtooth rooflights and a solid archive wing.

desc.zh: 中央喷泉、两侧反射池、绿篱花池与行道树。
desc.en: A central fountain, reflecting pools, hedged planters and trees.

desc.zh: 政务区的大道、侧街与人行道，建在中层核心区的甲板上。
desc.en: Avenues, side streets and pavements of the government quarter, on a deck in the mid-tier core.

desc.zh: 路灯、矮柱灯、护柱、长椅与候车亭。
desc.en: Street lights, bollard lamps, barrier posts, benches and a transit shelter.

desc.zh: 纯色全息屏与纯色垂幅（无文字）。
desc.en: Plain-colour hologram panels and solid banners (no text).
